module: Flowgraph node "Rally Clock" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Provides the current rally epoch time (currentEpochTime, seconds, rm:getEpochTime()) and the scheduled time of an event (scheduledEventTime, rm:getScheduledEventTime(eventName)) for the given event name (position name, e.g. "SS_start_line"). The scheduled time is cached and recomputed only when eventName or the current mission changes.

init.desc: Initializes the cache (event name, mission id, scheduled time) to nil.

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the cache when the graph starts.

work.desc: Every frame: updates currentEpochTime and scheduledEventTime (with cache).
